ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Adds a pull_request paths filter (shared/**, scripts/**, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, conftest.py, .gitattributes, .python-version, the workflow itself) to windows-tests.yml; push-to-main and workflow_dispatch stay unfiltered. No action added, no pin changed, no permission or secret touched, ci.yml untouched. Reduces when the non-required Windows job runs; does not widen the trust boundary.
